literal: That which is thought of all immediately will attain, if with the mind one does not harbor anger.
translation: If a person does not harbor anger even in their mind, they will immediately attain everything they think of.
modern: ஒருவர் தன் மனதால் கோபத்தை நினைக்காமல் இருந்தால், அவர் நினைத்தவை அனைத்தும் உடனே அவரை வந்தடையும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the immense mental power and clarity gained by conquering anger. The poet states that if a person completely avoids harboring anger within their mind, they gain such focus that whatever they desire or think of will be attained immediately. The repetition of the root word for mind and thought emphasizes that true self-control begins in the deep recesses of the mind. By keeping the mind free from the destructive heat of anger, one's thoughts gain the strength to manifest instantly.
